data.title: 黍 · 碧波稻风间的夏日小憩
data.action: 悠然坐在木栈桥边缘，双脚浸在潺潺水流中轻轻晃荡，单手托着洗净的带露野果，温婉笑着迎着带麦香的海风回看，发间翠绿禾苗发簪微颤
data.location: 临近入海口湿地的水生稻田边浅水木栈桥
data.lighting: 暖融融的金色晚霞与水波交辉，温润柔和
data.camera: 温暖中景侧视角，栈桥、流水与远方稻浪交融
data.mood: 温润母性、丰饶恬静、踏实从容
data.description: 入海口湿地金光流淌的傍晚。黍身着青苗丰岁蔓草交织连体泳装，赤足浸在清凉的溪流中。她手捧清甜瓜果转头微笑，翠绿禾簪迎风微颤，举手投足间带着大地神明般的丰饶温厚与让人心安的夏日暖意。
data.promptProse: Shu sitting peacefully along the edge of a weathered wooden boardwalk where tidal waters meet lush green marshlands. She wears a tasteful agrarian-inspired jade green and harvest-gold crossover monokini with subtle vine lace. Her feet dip playfully into the running cool water as she holds a fresh orchard fruit, turning back with an immensely comforting, benevolent elder-sister smile in the warm amber sunset.
data.animaCaption: Shu sits at the edge of a wooden boardwalk, holding a handful of washed fruit while her feet trail in the water.
